### Archer To Report Third Quarter 2026 Operating Update and Financial Results on November 9th, 2026


Oct 26, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/823642595/files/doc_news/Archer-To-Report-Third-Quarter-2026-Operating-Update-and-Financial-Results-on-November-9th-2026-2026.pdf)


SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Archer Aviation Inc. (NYSE: ACHR) will report its third quarter 2026 operating update and financial results after market close on Monday, November 9th, 2026. Archer will host a live webcast to discuss its results at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.


The live webcast and replay will be available at[investors.archer.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.archer.com&esheet=54628686&newsitemid=20261026648706&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.archer.com&index=1&md5=6cb94f2d0f0685a9ad423e073c165bb3) .To listen to the conference call, you can join the webcast by visiting[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/541539744](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F541539744&esheet=54628686&newsitemid=20261026648706&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F541539744&index=2&md5=c7747e9577e3a0578ce23c2a28dfd539) .


Archer will also utilize Say Technologies’ Q&A Platform to allow shareholders to submit and vote on questions by visiting[https://app.saytechnologies.com/archer-2026-q3](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.saytechnologies.com%2Farcher-2026-q3&esheet=54628686&newsitemid=20261026648706&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.saytechnologies.com%2Farcher-2026-q3&index=3&md5=73cc1b96337c4d2df23c4322edd7402d) .


**About Archer**


Archer builds the aircraft and core technologies that will define the next era of flight for aerospace.[www.archer.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.archer.com&esheet=54628686&newsitemid=20261026648706&lan=en-US&anchor=www.archer.com&index=4&md5=04b58cfdb9e541d0a437b59d982b8bfa)
